data.name: Deewanaht
data.gender_notes: Deewanaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is deeply in love and passionate about their beliefs or relationships. The name Deewanaht carries the meaning “Intense Lover” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Deewanaht usually hope their child will grow to embody intense lover and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A soul deeply devoted to love and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Deewanaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intense Lover.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deewanaht total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
